candidate.answerReason: The line through (1,1) with slope 2 satisfies y-1=2(x-1). At x=0 it has y=-1, so its y-intercept is -1.

review.mathematicalCheck: The unique line through \((1,1)\) with slope 2 satisfies \(y-1=2(x-1)\), hence \(y=2x-1\). Its value at \(x=0\), and therefore its y-intercept, is \(-1\). Both decisive steps appear.
review.levelCheck: Point-slope form and coordinate-axis intercepts suffice. The supplied tangent slope makes differentiation unnecessary.
